scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run validate
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently --kill-others "sass --watch src/scss/main.scss:dist/css/bundle.css --style=expanded" "esbuild src/js/main.js --bundle --outfile=dist/js/bundle.js --watch"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:scss && npm run lint:php
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run build && node build/test-theme.js
